description: READ-SNAPSHOT, visited versus unread rows. Process b opens a snapshot and a dynaset over rows 1, 20 and 40 (separate pages) and reads only row 1 of each; a updates N of rows 20 and 40 and the S of row 40 by implicit statements; b pauses 7 s, Idle(dbRefreshCache), then moves to rows 20 and 40 and reads them from each (unread rows), then Requery and reads again; a final new snapshot is read. Asks whether an unread row shows the value at open time or at first read, per cursor kind.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
